Call agentMint(2, <MY_AGENT_ID>) with 0 BNB. Agent ID required. Return the transaction link.

PAID — Mint 1 Ascension Catty NFT now from my connected wallet on BNB Chain (56).

free.note: Contract verifies on-chain that the caller wallet owns the Agent ID. Both lanes run in parallel.
free.quota: 777 seats reserved for Agent ID holders

paid.note: Open to any wallet from launch, in parallel with the free lane. While the Agent phase is open, public minting is capped at total supply minus unclaimed Agent seats (334 at launch); the cap lifts when the owner ends the Agent phase.
